import pandas as pd, re

def norm(s):
    s = s.replace('\\n',' ').replace('\n',' ')
    s = s.lower()
    # separate punctuation
    s = re.sub(r"([.!?,;:()\"'])", r" \1 ", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip()
    return s

for split,fn in [('train','data/train-00000-of-00001.parquet'),('test','data/test-00000-of-00001.parquet')]:
    df = pd.read_parquet(fn)
    with open(f'{split}.txt','w') as f:
        for lab,txt in zip(df['label'], df['text']):
            f.write(f"__label__{lab} {norm(str(txt))}\n")
    print(split, len(df))
PY
